text:
The change adds a receipt header containing the order ID, customer details, and total cents.

It crashes for orders whose user has been removed. `removeUser` deletes the user while stored orders remain, and `findUser` can return `undefined`. The non-null assertion provides no runtime protection, so accessing `user.name` throws. No tests were added to cover this case.
